title: Knee-Safe Core & Glute Ignition
description: High-tension glute and core bracing routine designed to fire up the posterior chain without placing sheer force on the knee joints. Uses isometric holds and anti-extension patterns to build functional strength.

warmup.name: Cat-Cow Segmental Mobility
warmup.notes: Move one vertebra at a time. Inhale on cow, exhale on cat.

warmup.name: Lying Hip Circles
warmup.notes: Draw large circles with the knee to mobilize the hip capsule.

exercises.name: Iso-Hold Glute Bridge with Heel Drive
exercises.coaching_cue: Drive through heels, brace abs, squeeze glutes at the top. Do NOT arch lower back.

exercises.name: Deadbug with Opposite Arm/Leg Reach
exercises.coaching_cue: Lower back must stay flat against the floor the entire time. Breathe out on extension.

main_blocks.block_name: Block B — Lateral Glute & Hip Stability

exercises.name: Lying Clamshells
exercises.coaching_cue: Keep hips stacked. Only rotate at the hip — do not roll the pelvis back.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog Hold
exercises.coaching_cue: Spine stays neutral. Do not let the lower back arch or rotate.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
exercises.coaching_cue: Raise leg to hip height only. Squeeze glute med at the top.

cooldown.name: Lying Figure-4 Glute Stretch
cooldown.notes: Keep head flat on mat. Pull thigh gently toward chest.

cooldown.name: Supine Spinal Twist
cooldown.notes: Let gravity do the work. Keep both shoulders on the floor.

title: Posture & Thoracic Reset
description: Targeted thoracic mobilization and posterior shoulder chain activation to reverse desk-hunch posture. All movements are shoulder and neck safe — no overhead pressing, no cervical strain.

warmup.name: Thoracic Foam Roll
warmup.notes: Roll from mid to upper back. Pause on tight segments for 5–10s.

exercises.name: Open Book Stretch (Side-Lying)
exercises.coaching_cue: Keep hips stacked. Follow top hand with eyes. Let the chest open fully.

exercises.name: Prone Cobra (Arms at Sides)
exercises.coaching_cue: Arms low beside hips. Lift chest by squeezing mid-back, not pushing with hands. Chin tucks slightly.

exercises.name: Wall Angels (Elbows Low)
exercises.coaching_cue: Keep elbows at 90° below shoulder height. Maintain constant wall contact — ribs, back, arms.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W Hold
exercises.coaching_cue: Thumbs up on Y and W. Squeeze mid-back, not neck.

exercises.name: Quadruped Shoulder Tap
exercises.coaching_cue: Keep hips level and square. Move arm slowly to challenge anti-rotation.

cooldown.name: Child's Pose with Diaphragmatic Breathing
cooldown.notes: Arms long in front. With each exhale, let chest sink lower.

cooldown.name: Seated Neck Side Stretch
cooldown.notes: Let weight of hand gently traction side of neck. No forcing.

title: Full-Body Low-Impact Strength
description: 30-minute zero-equipment full-body session built around compound bodyweight patterns — squat, hinge, push, pull — at a joint-safe tempo with zero plyometric impact.

warmup.name: High-Knee March in Place
warmup.notes: Arms pump opposite to legs.

warmup.name: Leg Swing (Forward/Back)
warmup.notes: Hold wall for balance. Keep swing controlled.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Box Squat
exercises.coaching_cue: Sit back to chair height. Chest tall, knees track over toes. Stand fully at top.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Slow Eccentric)
exercises.coaching_cue: Step BACK not forward. Front shin stays vertical. Less knee stress than forward lunge.

main_blocks.block_name: Block B — Upper Body Push & Pull

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up on Counter
exercises.coaching_cue: Straight plank from heels to head. Lower to chest level. Elbows at 45°, not flared wide.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row (Bodyweight Pull)
exercises.coaching_cue: Hold door frame, walk feet forward, lean back. Pull chest toward door leading with elbows.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift Touch-Down
exercises.coaching_cue: Hinge at hip, send one leg back as counterweight. Touch floor with opposite hand. Back stays flat.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank with Hip Dip
exercises.coaching_cue: Rigid torso. Rotate hips slowly side to side. Do not sag at lower back.

cooldown.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
cooldown.notes: Posterior pelvic tilt first, then lunge gently.

cooldown.name: Seated Forward Fold
cooldown.notes: Hinge from hips. Let hamstrings release passively.

title: SI-Joint & Pelvic Stability Flow
description: 15-minute protocol to stabilize the sacroiliac joint and surrounding pelvic musculature. Bilateral, symmetrical positions only — no asymmetrical loading.

warmup.name: 90/90 Hip Rotation (Seated)
warmup.notes: Shift between both sides. Spine tall. No pain.

main_blocks.block_name: Block A — Pelvic Control & Glute Activation

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilts
exercises.coaching_cue: Flatten lower back into floor, hold 2s. Return to neutral. Tiny movement, maximum attention.

exercises.name: Bilateral Glute Bridge (Slow)
exercises.coaching_cue: Use both legs equally. No hip shift — stay symmetrical. Brace abs before lifting.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog (Anti-Rotation Focus)
exercises.coaching_cue: Move like you are balancing a glass of water on your lower back. Zero pelvic rotation.

exercises.name: Clamshell (Controlled)
exercises.coaching_cue: Feet together, top knee opens like clamshell. Do not roll pelvis backward.

cooldown.name: Lying Knee-to-Chest Hug (Both Legs)
cooldown.notes: Both knees pulled gently to chest. Rock side to side slowly.

cooldown.name: Supported Child's Pose
cooldown.notes: Knees wide, big toes touch. Sink hips back. Deep exhales.

title: Knee-Safe Posterior Chain & Glutes
description: 20-minute dumbbell and band session laser-focused on the posterior chain. Heavy glute work and RDL patterns build real strength without loaded knee flexion.

warmup.name: Banded Side Steps (Monster Walk)
warmup.notes: Band above knees. Wide stance. Keep tension throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.coaching_cue: Hinge at hips, not spine. Dumbbells trace the legs down. Feel hamstring stretch. Squeeze glutes to rise.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickback (Hip Extension)
exercises.coaching_cue: On all fours with dumbbell behind knee. Drive heel to ceiling. Squeeze glute at top. No hip tilt.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge with Dumbbell on Hips
exercises.coaching_cue: Band above knees adds lateral challenge. Hold dumbbell on hip bones. Squeeze at top like cracking a walnut.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Abduction (Standing)
exercises.coaching_cue: Band around ankles. Lift lateral leg to 45°. Do not lean to opposite side.

cooldown.name: Pigeon Pose (or Figure-4 if Knee Sensitive)
cooldown.notes: Let gravity open the hip. No forcing.

title: Upper Body Strength & Posture Fix
description: 30-minute dumbbell pressing and pulling session prioritizing posterior shoulder development, scapular retraction, and anti-rounding patterns to counteract desk posture.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart (Chest Level)
warmup.notes: Arms straight, pull band to chest height. Squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.coaching_cue: Brace core, hinge 45°. Elbow drives back and up. Squeeze mid-back at top.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.coaching_cue: Lie prone on incline surface. Chest supported eliminates lower back compensation. Pull elbows back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.coaching_cue: Lying flat. Press straight up. Elbows at 45° from body. Shoulder-safe pressing alternative.

exercises.name: Banded Face Pull (Chest Height)
exercises.coaching_cue: Band at face height. Pull to forehead, elbows high. Externally rotate shoulders at end of pull.

exercises.name: Dumbbell External Rotation (Lying)
exercises.coaching_cue: Elbow fixed at 90° against ribs. Rotate forearm toward ceiling. Light weight, maximum control.

cooldown.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
cooldown.notes: Forearm on door frame. Gentle lean forward. No pain in shoulder front.

title: Anti-Extension Core & Unilateral Legs
description: 30-minute session combining anti-extension core training with unilateral leg work for symmetrical strength and injury prevention.

warmup.name: Cat-Cow + Thread-the-Needle
warmup.notes: Combine spinal articulation with thoracic rotation.

exercises.name: McGill Modified Curl-Up
exercises.coaching_cue: One knee bent, one leg straight. Hands under lower back. Lift ONLY head and upper shoulders. Zero lumbar flexion.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Band Anti-Rotation)
exercises.coaching_cue: Band anchored to side. Press out and hold — resist rotation. The harder you brace, the better this works.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.coaching_cue: Rear foot elevated. Front knee tracks over 2nd toe. Torso upright. Queen of unilateral leg work.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.coaching_cue: One leg extended to ceiling. Drive through grounded heel only. Level hips throughout.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Adductor Plank (Modified from Knee)
exercises.coaching_cue: Bottom knee on floor. Top foot on chair. Lift hips. Targets inner thigh powerfully.

cooldown.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
cooldown.notes: Sit with both knees at 90°. Lean forward over front shin.

title: Full-Body Hypertrophy & Bone Builder
description: 45-minute dumbbell hypertrophy session for bone density in peri/post-menopausal women. Emphasizes mechanical tension through compound lifts with slow eccentrics and longer rest to avoid cortisol spike.

warmup.name: Brisk March in Place
warmup.notes: Gradually elevate heart rate. Swing arms.

warmup.name: Dynamic Leg Swings
warmup.notes: Forward, backward, and cross-body patterns.

main_blocks.block_name: Block A — Lower Body Heavy (Bone Loading)

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat (Heavy)
exercises.coaching_cue: Hold heaviest dumbbell at chest. Squat to parallel, elbows inside knees. Axial load stimulates femoral bone density.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (Heavy)
exercises.coaching_cue: Maximum tension through posterior chain. Feel every inch of the eccentric. Spine absolutely neutral.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row (Heavy)
exercises.coaching_cue: Pull elbows back hard. Mid-back should be burning by rep 8.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press (Seated)
exercises.coaching_cue: Seated removes lumbar risk. Press to lockout. Do not arch lower back. Axial shoulder loading builds clavicle density.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry (Bilateral)
exercises.coaching_cue: Heaviest pair you can carry with tall posture. Bracing core against load is phenomenal for spinal density.

cooldown.name: Static Hip Flexor Stretch
cooldown.notes: After heavy squatting, hip flexors need release.

cooldown.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
cooldown.notes: Leg straight toward ceiling. Use a band to assist.

title: Micro-Dose Dumbbell Express
description: 15-minute full-body dumbbell EMOM for the time-poor woman who refuses to compromise on quality. Compound movements only, no fluff, maximum hormonal benefit per minute.

warmup.name: 1-Min High-Knee March
warmup.notes: Pump the arms. Get blood moving.

main_blocks.block_name: EMOM — Every Minute on the Minute (12 Minutes)

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.coaching_cue: Heavy dumbbell at chest. Full depth. Explode up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Push Press
exercises.coaching_cue: Slight knee dip, drive dumbbells overhead. Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.coaching_cue: Pure hip hinge. Load the hamstrings. Drive hips forward to stand.

cooldown.name: Standing Forward Fold
cooldown.notes: Shake the head yes/no gently to release the neck.

title: Wrist-Free Arm & Shoulder Builder
description: 30-minute upper body session for women with wrist, carpal tunnel, or hand arthritis. All exercises use forearm pads, bands, or neutral grips to eliminate wrist compression.

warmup.name: Arm Circles + Thoracic Rotation
warmup.notes: Small to large circles. No weight. Warm up the rotator cuff.

exercises.name: Band Chest Press (Forearm Loop)
exercises.coaching_cue: Loop band around your back, hold ends with forearm neutral (thumbs up). Press forward. No wrist extension.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Raise (Ankle Cuff on Wrist)
exercises.coaching_cue: Strap ankle cuff to wrist/forearm. Step on band. Raise arm to shoulder height. Zero wrist engagement.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.coaching_cue: Elbows directly under shoulders. Fists together or forearms flat. Squeeze glutes, abs, quads.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull (Elbows High)
exercises.coaching_cue: Thumb-up grip. Pull to forehead. Elbows high and wide. Works rear deltoids and external rotators.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Neutral Grip)
exercises.coaching_cue: Thumbs up grip keeps wrist neutral the entire movement. Minimizes wrist and forearm strain.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Band)
exercises.coaching_cue: Hold band loop with closed fist or forearm. Extend arms overhead. Elbow stays close to head.

cooldown.name: Forearm Stretch (Both Directions)
cooldown.notes: Extend arm, flex wrist up then down with opposite hand.

title: Heavy Bone Density — Squat & Hinge Focus
description: 45-minute gym session around the most powerful bone density stimuli: axial loading through barbell squats, RDLs, and leg press. Heavy weight, long rest, zero cortisol spike.

warmup.name: 5-Min Incline Treadmill Walk
warmup.notes: 15% incline, 3.0–3.5 mph. Loads femur and hip without impact.

warmup.name: Dynamic Hip Mobilization Leg Swings
warmup.notes: Forward/back, side/side. Hold a wall.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.coaching_cue: Bar on traps. Sit back and down. Knees track over toes. This is the #1 bone density exercise for women.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.coaching_cue: Bar stays close to legs. Feel glutes and hamstrings loading eccentrically. Squeeze through hips at top.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Foot High = Glute Focus)
exercises.coaching_cue: Feet high on platform. Do NOT lock out knees. Slow 4-sec eccentric loads quads and bones.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through (Glute Hinge)
exercises.coaching_cue: Cable through legs. Hinge back, feel glute stretch. Drive hips forward. Glutes do all the work.

cooldown.name: Static Hamstring Stretch
cooldown.notes: Leg on bench, hinge from hips.

cooldown.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cooldown.notes: After heavy squatting, extend hip back and breathe.

title: Spine-Neutral Machine Strength
description: 30-minute gym session using machines to keep the spine supported throughout. Zero free-weight spinal loading. Perfect for lower back history.

warmup.name: McGill Big 3 (Bird-Dog, Side Plank, Modified Curl-Up)
warmup.notes: Pre-activate spinal stabilizers before loading.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Back Fully Supported)
exercises.coaching_cue: Full back contact with pad at all times. Do not lift lower back off seat. Spine-neutral pressing.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Curl Machine
exercises.coaching_cue: Curl heels toward glutes under control. The 4-second return is where the real work happens.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.coaching_cue: Sit upright. Pull elbows past torso. No spine rocking — core braced, back tall.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.coaching_cue: Seat adjusted so handles are at chest level. Press out, return slow. Back never leaves the pad.

cooldown.name: Passive Spinal Hang (Chin-Up Bar, Light Grip)
cooldown.notes: Gentle lumbar traction after loaded session.

title: Upper Body Pull & Push Complex
description: 45-minute gym session built on compound pulling and pressing patterns. Rear deltoid and lat development create a strong, pain-free shoulder ecosystem.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart (Chest Height)
warmup.notes: External rotation warm-up. Elbows straight.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
exercises.coaching_cue: Initiate by depressing shoulder blades DOWN before bending elbows. Pull to upper chest. Squeeze lats at bottom.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Close Grip)
exercises.coaching_cue: Chest to pads. Pull elbows behind body. Hold squeeze 2s. No spine rocking.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull (Elbows High & Wide)
exercises.coaching_cue: Rope at face height. Elbows fly high and wide. External rotation at end range. Rear delt and rotator cuff gold.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Press
exercises.coaching_cue: 30–45° incline. Elbows at 45° from torso. Press to lockout.

cooldown.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
cooldown.notes: After heavy pressing always open the chest.

cooldown.name: Lat Stretch (Wall Assisted)
cooldown.notes: One arm at a time. Let the lat fully elongate.

title: Wrist-Free Machine & Cable Upper Body
description: 30-minute gym session for women with wrist, carpal tunnel, or hand arthritis. Uses machine pads, forearm-loaded cables, and ankle-cuff attachments to completely eliminate wrist compression.

warmup.name: Arm Circles & Thoracic Rotation
warmup.notes: No resistance. Full range of motion. Wake up rotator cuffs.

main_blocks.block_name: Block A — Machine Press & Fly (No Grip)

exercises.name: Pec Deck / Machine Fly (Forearms on Pads)
exercises.coaching_cue: Place forearms against pads, NOT hands gripping. Squeeze chest. No wrist loading whatsoever.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise (Ankle Cuff on Forearm)
exercises.coaching_cue: Strap ankle cuff to forearm/wrist. Raise to shoulder height. Side delt isolation with zero grip.

exercises.name: Machine Row (Neutral Grip Handles)
exercises.coaching_cue: Use a light grip — movement driven by elbows and mid-back, not hand strength.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.coaching_cue: Fists together or forearms flat. Zero wrist extension. Gold standard for wrist-sensitive core work.

cooldown.name: Chest Opening Stretch on Foam Roller
cooldown.notes: Roller along spine. Arms out to sides. Gravity opens chest.

title: Lower Body Knee-Bulletproofing
description: 45-minute gym session to build lateral stability, VMO strength, and posterior chain resilience that protects the knee joint during sport and everyday life.

warmup.name: Banded Monster Walk (Lateral Side Steps)
warmup.notes: Band above knees. Wide stance. Stay low. Fire glute medius.

exercises.name: Banded Spanish Squat (Band Behind Knees)
exercises.coaching_cue: Band behind knees pulls tibias back, offloading patellar tendon. Sit deep, chest up. VMO fires maximally.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (Band TKE)
exercises.coaching_cue: Band behind knee. Leg slightly bent. Extend to full lockout. Isolates VMO without patellar shear.

main_blocks.block_name: Block B — Lateral Chain & Hip Stability

exercises.name: Lateral Dumbbell Step-Up (Low Box, Slow Eccentric)
exercises.coaching_cue: Step up with outside leg. The 4-second lowering trains knee stabilizers eccentrically. DO NOT drop down fast.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Adductor Plank (Modified from Knee)
exercises.coaching_cue: Top foot on bench. Bottom knee on floor. Lift hips. Powerful adductor/groin training for ACL support.

main_blocks.block_name: Block C — Posterior Chain Knee Support

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Curl Machine
exercises.coaching_cue: Strong hamstrings prevent ACL injury. 4-second lowering is key.

cooldown.name: Calf Stretch on Step
cooldown.notes: Heel drops below step level. Straight knee then bent knee.

cooldown.name: Deep Achilles Stretch (Knee Bent, Heel Down)
cooldown.notes: Bent knee variant targets Achilles/soleus specifically.

title: Full-Body Cable & Dumbbell Circuit
description: 30-minute time-efficient gym circuit combining cable machine fluidity with dumbbell compound strength. Minimal setup changes, maximum full-body stimulus.

warmup.name: Brisk Bike or Rower
warmup.notes: Build a light sweat. Prep the full body for compound loading.

exercises.name: Cable Goblet Squat (Low Pulley)
exercises.coaching_cue: Hold cable at chest. Squat to parallel. Squeeze glutes on the way up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Push Press
exercises.coaching_cue: Drive from legs, press overhead. Eccentric return is the muscle builder.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through (Hip Hinge)
exercises.coaching_cue: Cable between legs, hinge back to feel glutes load, drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.coaching_cue: Hinge to 45°. Pull elbows past torso. Both arms simultaneously.

cooldown.name: Full-Body Roll-Down Stretch
cooldown.notes: Stand tall, chin to chest, roll down vertebra by vertebra. Hang for 30s.

title: Evening Decompression & Parasympathetic Reset
description: 15-minute end-of-day ritual to down-regulate the nervous system, decompress the spine, and shift from sympathetic to parasympathetic mode. Perfect for sleep quality.

exercises.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
exercises.coaching_cue: The long exhale activates the vagus nerve. This is your reset switch. Close your eyes.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-The-Wall (Viparita Karani)
exercises.coaching_cue: Hips close to wall, legs vertical. Let gravity reverse the day's compression. Arms relaxed by sides, palms up.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist
exercises.coaching_cue: Both shoulders stay on mat. Breathe into the side being stretched.

main_blocks.block_name: Block C — Hip & Lower Body Release

exercises.name: Lying Figure-4 (Piriformis Release)
exercises.coaching_cue: Cradle the leg, breathe deeply. With each exhale, gently pull the thigh closer.

cooldown.name: Savasana with Diaphragmatic Breathing
cooldown.notes: Arms at sides, palms up. Scan the body top to bottom. Release every muscle.

title: Somatic Floor-Based Core & Spine Unloading
description: 20-minute mat-based slow-motion neuromuscular session to build deep core stability and release accumulated spinal compression — without any load on the spine.

warmup.name: Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
warmup.notes: 4s in, 4s hold, 4s out, 4s hold. Prepare nervous system for somatic work.

exercises.name: Slow-Motion Deadbug (3-Second Pace)
exercises.coaching_cue: This is neuromuscular practice, not exercise. Feel the transverse abdominis engage. Lower back absolutely flat.

exercises.name: Pilates Toe Taps
exercises.coaching_cue: Tabletop position. Lower one foot to tap floor, return. Pelvis stays completely neutral throughout.

exercises.name: Modified Side Plank from Knees
exercises.coaching_cue: Bottom knee down. Body straight from knee to shoulder. Hip does NOT sag. Breathe freely.

cooldown.name: Supported Bridge Pose (Pillow Under Sacrum)
cooldown.notes: Pillow under lower back/sacrum. Completely passive. Let hip flexors release.

title: Deep Hip & Ankle Mobility Overhaul
description: 30-minute mobility session targeting the two most commonly restricted joints in women 40+: the hip capsule and ankle dorsiflexion. Improved mobility reduces knee and lower back pain downstream.

warmup.name: 90/90 Hip Rotation Flow
warmup.notes: Shift between both sides. Internal and external rotation. No pain.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold with Ankle Oscillation
exercises.coaching_cue: Heels on floor. Use hands on thighs or hold a support. Let hips sink. Rock gently side to side.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (or Figure-4)
exercises.coaching_cue: Let gravity do the work. Do NOT force it. Breathe into the hip. The tighter it is, the slower you go.

exercises.name: Ankle CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
exercises.reps: 5 slow circles each direction per ankle
exercises.coaching_cue: Maximize range in every direction. Keep the leg still — only the ankle moves.

exercises.name: Wall Ankle Stretch (Knee Drives Over Pinky Toe)
exercises.coaching_cue: Foot close to wall. Drive knee toward outside of foot. Heel stays flat. Directly improves squat depth.

main_blocks.block_name: Block C — Hip Flexor & Adductor Release

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch with Overhead Reach
exercises.coaching_cue: Posterior pelvic tilt before shifting forward. Overhead reach opens thoracic spine simultaneously.

exercises.name: Wide-Stance Adductor Squat Stretch (Frog Pose)
exercises.coaching_cue: Knees wide over toes. Elbows on inner thighs to deepen stretch. Rock forward-back gently.

cooldown.name: Savasana
cooldown.notes: Let the body integrate the mobility work. Zero effort.

title: Desk-Hunch Relief & Chest Opening
description: 20-minute targeted session for chronically hunched posture from desk work. Opens the pec minor, anterior shoulder capsule, and thoracic spine while activating the opposing weak mid-back muscles.

warmup.name: Foam Roll Thoracic Spine
warmup.notes: Roll from T1 to T12. Pause on each sticky segment for a slow breath.

main_blocks.block_name: Block A — Pec Minor & Anterior Capsule Release

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch (Low, Mid, High Position)
exercises.coaching_cue: Change arm height each set: Low (below shoulder), Mid (shoulder height), High (above). Each targets different pec fiber.

exercises.name: Open Book Stretch
exercises.coaching_cue: Side-lying. Follow top hand with eyes. Let chest open like a book. Breathe into it.

exercises.name: Prone Superman Hold
exercises.coaching_cue: Arms in Y, thumbs up. Lift chest and legs simultaneously. Mid-back and glutes working. No neck strain.

exercises.name: Wall Angels (Low Elbow Variation)
exercises.coaching_cue: Spine flat on wall. Elbows and wrists touch wall entire movement. Slow slide up and down. Postural gold.

main_blocks.block_name: Block C — Neck & Tech Neck Release

exercises.name: Chin Tuck + Cervical Retraction
exercises.coaching_cue: Draw chin straight back (not down). Think: make a double chin. Corrects forward head posture directly.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Side Stretch
exercises.coaching_cue: Ear toward shoulder. Opposite hand gently adds traction. Never pull aggressively.

cooldown.name: Foam Roller Chest Opening (T-Spine Extension)
cooldown.notes: Roller perpendicular to spine. Arms cross or extend overhead. Pure passive gravity opening.
